interface.signature: def longestSubstring(s: str, k: int) -> int

preconditions.expression: isinstance(s, str) and all(c.islower() for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input s must be a string consisting only of lowercase letters.
The input k must be a positive integer.

postconditions.description: The return value must be a non-negative integer representing the length of the longest substring.
The return value must not exceed the length of the input string s.

postconditions.expression: all(s.count(c) >= k for c in set(s)) or return_value == 0
postconditions.description: If the return value is greater than 0, every character in the longest substring must appear at least k times.
